Title: Announcing General Availability of Azure API Management Basic v2 and Standard v2 Tiers

Body.Content:
We're thrilled to announce the General Availability of Azure API Management's newest pricing tiers – Basic v2 and Standard v2.

The introduction of these new tiers directly addresses common customer requests, enhancing quality-of-service and enabling businesses of all sizes to leverage API Management effectively. 

The Azure API Management v2 pricing tiers represent a significant leap forward, offering a comprehensive range of capabilities tailored to projects of all sizes, from small-scale endeavors to large-scale enterprise applications. Importantly, these new v2 pricing tiers are available alongside our existing Azure API Management classic pricing tiers, ensuring continuity for users. It's worth noting that the Azure API Management classic pricing tiers remain actively supported and invested in.  

With the Basic v2 and Standard v2 tiers, customers can seamlessly embark on their API Management journey and effortlessly scale their API programs as they expand. This launch underscores our ongoing commitment to delivering state-of-the-art solutions that empower organizations to thrive in today's digital landscape. 

Check out the links below to get up to speed on the new pricing tiers. 

  • Azure API Management v2 Pricing 

  • Azure API Management v2 Documentation
